title: Cross-product Modelling in Continuous Intraday Electricity Markets via Hawkes Processes
abstract: arXiv:2610.23619v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As renewable energy integration accelerates, intraday continuous (IDC) electricity markets have become essential for short-term balancing. However, the simultaneous trading of overlapping contracts with varying granularities creates complex, hidden liquidity dependencies that are critical to market stability but remain poorly understood. This paper proposes a multivariate State-Dependent Hawkes Process (SDHP) to model cross-product liquidity dynamics between Quarter-Hourly and Hourly IDC contracts. To determine how cross-product effects vary under different market conditions, we classify the trading sessions into two distinct regimes: 'Normal' and 'Stressed', based on a composite metric of the bid-ask spread, mid-price volatility and queue imbalance. translated_title: 基于霍克斯过程的连续日内电力市场跨产品建模
translated_abstract: 随着可再生能源并网加速，日内连续电力市场已成为短期电力平衡的重要手段。然而，不同粒度的重叠合约同时交易，形成了复杂且隐蔽的流动性依赖关系，这对市场稳定性至关重要，但目前仍缺乏充分理解。本文提出了一种多元状态依赖霍克斯过程，用于建模十五分钟合约与一小时日内连续合约之间的跨产品流动性动态。为了确定跨产品效应在不同市场条件下如何变化，我们基于买卖价差、中间价波动率和队列失衡的综合指标，将交易时段划分为“正常”和“压力”两种不同的市场状态。该模型使用荷兰EPEX SPOT日内连续市场的三级限价订单簿数据，在2024年每个季度的第一个月进行校准。我们发现订单流…（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种多元状态依赖霍克斯过程，用于建模连续日内电力市场中十五分钟与一小时合约之间的跨产品流动性动态，并依据买卖价差、价格波动率和队列失衡将市场划分为“正常”与“压力”两种状态来刻画跨产品效应的差异。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multivariate State-Dependent Hawkes Process to model cross-product liquidity dynamics between Quarter-Hourly and Hourly contracts in continuous intraday electricity markets, classifying trading sessions into Normal and Stressed regimes to capture regime-dependent cross-product effects.
